status: Ninja footwear and sleek hoverboard concept for review before Meshy
prompt:
Edit the supplied Neon Exorcist hoverboard rider concept with two precise changes. Preserve the same male character identity, hair/topknot, smooth orange-magenta single-screen visor covering the eyes and nose while mouth/jaw stay exposed, fitted technical jacket, talismans, neon cyan/magenta/orange/yellow palette, black streetwear, full-body riding pose, gray studio backdrop and detailed realistic AAA game concept rendering.

1. FOOTWEAR: replace the bulky sneakers with MUCH SMALLER, close-fitting futuristic ninja footwear. Sleek black tabi-inspired shoes with a subtle split-toe shape, soft technical fabric, snug ankle wraps, thin flexible soles, and minimal cyan/orange seam accents. Human-scale narrow feet, compact silhouette, no chunky outsole, no oversized toe box, no sneaker laces, no heavy armor. Both feet remain clearly planted on the board.

2. HOVERBOARD: redesign the same single connected board into a much sleeker aerodynamic vehicle. A thin black carbon-composite deck with smoothly tapered pointed/rounded ends, elegant continuous curves and a clean low-profile monocoque shell, approximately one-third the thickness of the current bulky board. Reduce width slightly while retaining usable foot space for the same riding stance. Remove exposed chunky mechanical boxes, bulky armored side modules and oversized external thruster pods. Use flush recessed levitation strips integrated into the underside, restrained cyan underglow and a narrow orange/magenta illuminated edge. Subtle grippy foot pads and finely machined surface detail. A premium lightweight futuristic surf/skateboard silhouette. No wheels. The entire slim board floats above the floor with a visible air gap, soft shadow and controlled colored reflections.

Composition: exactly one character riding ONE hoverboard, both feet visible and supported by the deck, whole head-to-board view with both board tips fully in frame, no inset views, no labels, no logo or watermark. All other design details stay unchanged.
